en.deleteAllBlocked: Probes are still live. Force stop first — deleting a session log while its turn is running would corrupt it.
en.deleteAllHint: Remove every probe conversation from disk — including ones already cleared from this list — and reset numbering to 1.
en.discardChinese: Discard when the chain-of-thought is mostly Chinese (80%+)
en.empty: No probes yet. Set a prompt and press Start.
en.emptyAllDiscarded: All {count} probes so far were discarded. Still fishing.
en.forceStopHint: Stop launching and abort every conversation still in flight.
en.noteForceStopped: Force stopped. Every probe in flight was aborted.
en.noteHit: Caught one — launching paused. Press Resume to continue.
en.noteLaunchFailed: Three probes in a row failed to start, so launching stopped. Press Resume to try again. Last error: {error}
en.notePaused: Paused. Live probes will finish on their own; press Resume to keep fishing.
en.notePausedCulled: Paused. {count} probes already judged as the old model were cancelled; the undecided ones run on.
en.noteReaped: Swept {count} untracked probe conversations out of the folder.
en.notifNone: This harness has no desktop notifications.
en.orphans: {count} probe conversations in this folder are not tracked by this console.
en.preflightBody: A run opens one conversation per probe. Probe prompts are sent as plugin messages, so DSH Desktop will not raise a system notification for them — but anything else you have running still will.
en.promptPlaceholder: Ask something that makes it reason at length
en.protectHint: Keep this conversation on disk and exempt it from cleanup. Force stop can still end its active turn.
en.protectRetryHint: Keep was not written to disk. The conversation is safe in this process; retry before restarting.
en.scoringHint: “Let me” opening a paragraph is decisive against. “I’ll” opening the whole chain-of-thought is decisive for. “We need” at the start is only a negative opening — the summariser often restates the task that way, then writes I’ll / I’m in even paragraphs with pauses between bursts.
en.selfCheckBad: Self-check {agreed}/{total} — your thresholds disagree with {n} labelled samples
en.selfCheckHint: Runs {total} hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the classifier under the settings above. No tokens, no probes — it is how you can tell "nothing found" apart from "nothing findable".
en.tagline: Start throwaway conversations and score their chain-of-thought to find a limited-rollout model.
en.timingHint: Rollout models generate at ~40–50 chunks/s with distinctive latency. Discarding out-of-range probes saves tokens early.
en.title: Rollout Scout
en.unprotectHint: Kept on disk. Click to hand it back to cleanup rules.
en.unprotectRetryHint: Unkeep was not written to disk. The existing Keep remains in force; retry the removal.
